_doc: The archives BrokenDev restores into BROKENDEV_HOME. 'file' is relative to the archives folder (BROKENDEV_ARCHIVES, default: the parent of BROKENDEV_HOME, i.e. P:\BrokenDev). 'stripTop' removes the archive's single top-level folder. 'include'/'exclude' are archive paths relative to that top folder (7-Zip wildcards); an empty include means everything. 'roots' name folders (relative to extractTo) that manifests refer to as {root:<name>}. 'sentinels' are files that must exist after a restore: a restore that lacks one is reported as failed. Nothing here is ever copied into git.
